variants.headline: Party divides in two
variants.body: The party {party} has split, with {splinter} the new breakaway party. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: A political organisation breaks apart
variants.body: A split in {party} has produced the new party {splinter}. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: Unity gives way to a party split
variants.body: The new party {splinter} has broken away from {party}. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.
